72295d78:  ;
 ;Routine DGJTEE2 handles the following functionality:
 ;1. If the entry is an edit, call the EDIT code.
 ;2. If it is a new entry, call the code for entering new data.
 ;3. It also contains the INCSP subroutine that sets some labels from
 ;   the Hospital Integration Utilities global.
 ;4. It has logic for listing all admissions and allowing the user to
 ;   select one.
 ;5. And it has initialization code for various forms.
3d7bec21: ;if it is an edit, call the EDIT code and quit.
dce4d0d0: ;if it is a new entry, call the NEW data entry code.
68381e3e: ;Quit the routine.
95cca886: ;Clear the VALMBCK variable which stores the refresh action.
26fb322b: ;If the record type is one of OP REPORT, DISCHARGE SUMMARY or INTERIM SUMMARY, call INIT^DGJTEE2 to initialize the form and set VALMBCK to 'R' to refresh the screen. Then quit.
0498b248: ;Call the INIT4 routine to initialize the form for editing a deficiency.
2e375577: ;Set VALMBCK to 'R' to refresh the screen and quit.

5b37e129:  ;
 ;The INCSP subroutine sets up some global variable references
 ;from the Hospital Integration Utilities global. It sets:
 ;TC, TW - the column and width for the Record Type field
 ;DC, DW - the column and width for the Deficiency field
 ;PC, PW - the column and width for the Physician field
 ;SC, SW - the column and width for the Status field
 ;CC, CW - the column and width for the Category field
 ;EC, EW - the column and width for the Event Date field
 ;CM - the internal entry number for 'COMPLETED' in file 393.2
 ;RV - the internal entry number for 'REVIEWED' in file 393.2
 ;SN - the internal entry number for 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' in file 393.2
a2afab75: ;If DGJTREC is defined, set TC and TW from the Record Type field definition.
06b0d768: ;If DGJTREC is not defined, set DC and DW from the Deficiency field definition.
fb19d3ea: ;Set PC and PW from the Physician field definition.
ca5b1103: ;Set SC and SW from the Status field definition.
80ee7b1b: ;Set CC and CW from the Category field definition.
ee232200: ;Set EC and EW from the Event Date field definition.
725e2f04: Set CM to the internal entry number for the 'COMPLETED' status code in the DEFICIENCY STATUS file (#393.2).
3efba034: Set RV to the internal entry number for the 'REVIEWED' status code in the DEFICIENCY STATUS file (#393.2).
428cf702: Set SN to the internal entry number for the 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' status code in the DEFICIENCY STATUS file (#393.2).
dbd2f5c3: Exit the INCSP subroutine.
52324956: Initialize counters DGJTCT (total count), DGJC (quit flag), and DGJTX (selected admission).
